name: 04_duplicate_on_retry
description: Insert commits, ack times out, retry inserts the batch again; exits 0.
expected_outcome: Each of the 10 orders appears exactly once in orders.db.

checks.name: no duplicate orders
checks.query: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING n > 1
checks.evidence_query: SELECT id, order_id, amount, loaded_at FROM orders WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY order_id, id
